events.title: 에리크 캉토나 returns from his eight-month suspension to score a late equaliser from the penalty spot in a 2–2 home draw with 리버풀 . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 extend their lead to four points with a 3–1 win at 에버턴.
페예노르트 fires manager 빌럼 판 하네험 and names 아리 한 as his successor.

요크 시티 eliminate 맨체스터 유나이티드 from the League Cup despite their Premier League opponents winning 3–1 in the second round second leg at Bootham Crescent . Striker 폴 스콜스 scores twice, with United's other goal coming from teenage winger Terry Cooke , who only made his competitive debut last month.

에버턴 striker Duncan Ferguson is sentenced to three months' imprisonment for assault for head butting Raith Rovers player John McStay 18 months ago, when he was still playing for 레인저스 . making him the first British professional footballer to be imprisoned for an on-field offence.

20-year-old striker 폴 스콜스 scores the only goal of the Manchester derby at Old Trafford , aiding United's title challenge and pushing City further into relegation trouble. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain four points ahead at the top with a 3–2 win at QPR. 아스널 go third by beating Leeds 3–0 at Elland Road .
미들즈브러 sign 22-year-old Brazilian midfielder Juninho in a £4.75million deal.

레스 퍼디낸드 scores a hat-trick in 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's 6–1 home league win against 윔블던, and 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain in second place with a 4–1 away victory over 첼시. The gap remains four points wide. 미들즈브러‘s fine start to life back in the Premier League continues with a 1–0 home win over QPR keeping their hold on fourth place. Down in Division One, West Bromwich go second with a 2–1 home win over 포츠머스 , sparking hope at The Hawthorns that Albion are close to ending their decade-long absence from the top flight.

The Football Association announces that the 72 Football League clubs would receive an additional £21 million in television revenue after they failed to agree on an initial sum of nearly £120 million. 리버풀's 이언 러시 scores twice in a 6–0 home league win against 맨체스터 시티, who are still without a win after 11 games, and 리즈 유나이티드 captain 게리 매캘리스터 scores a hat-trick in a 3–1 home league win over 코번트리 시티. 밀월 knock 레스터 시티 off the top of Division One with a 2–1 win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, while 레스터 시티 lose 3–2 at home to 크리스털 팰리스.
Striker John McGinlay scores for struggling 볼턴 원더러스 in a surprise 1–0 home win against 아스널.
